note: 这些是本轮实际检索和下载。正文放在 audit/staged-sources-29，尚未写入 evidence.jsonl，也未 apply。不计分。

failures.result: response was HTML, not a PDF

executed.support: women employment and femininity personality traits survey did not become less feminine
executed.counter: the same results included lower self-rated femininity among working women
executed.excerpt: working women feel increasingly less feminine than nonworking women
executed.why: Forthcoming 稿，没有出版日。自评女性气质不是原句里雌性仍在、功能更多。不计分。

executed.support: girls education curriculum shifted from attracting a husband to training for motherhood historical evidence
executed.counter: Hayes page shows colleges returned toward wife-and-mother justification
executed.why: 条件是社会真的像自称的那样看重母职。1984 年的历史文章没有写这个条件已经成立。不计分。

executed.support: marital satisfaction trend after dual earner couples economic dependence of wives declined
executed.counter: Utah brief: divorce penalty for wives earning as much disappeared, which is stability not higher fulfilment
executed.why: 经济阶段被超越这一条件没有出现。离婚风险不是更高的婚姻实现。不计分。

executed.support: housing quality and home health of employed women compared with housewives
executed.counter: not separately fetched; the support hits were quality-of-life, not home life made true and beautiful
executed.why: Springer 页是拦截页。没有可引用正文。尚未完成。

executed.support: demand growth for apartment buildings with professional childcare and centralized housekeeping
executed.counter: NYC survey is a preference, not the named establishment being supplied
executed.why: 纽约租户想要清洁服务，不是经理统一雇用清洁工、屋顶花园、日托和幼儿园这一整套供给已经必须被满足。不计分。

executed.counter: cohousing or service apartment with nursery commercial failure
executed.why: 一家合作托育在 2021 年 4 月上旬关闭。文章日期 2022-11-27。一家关闭不是这种永久供给是否成为普遍的商业成功。不计分。

executed.support: historical trend personal hygiene and domestic cleanliness since 1900
executed.counter: the saved book describes the start of the change, not a measured cleaner-than-ever series through the cutoff
executed.why: 版权页 © 2006。文献讲的是卫生史的开端，不是我们比以往任何时候都更清洁这一可核对序列。不计分。

executed.support: professionalized housework quality results compared with unpaid family housework
executed.counter: hits were time saved and willingness to pay, not better results in the expert-cleaning industries just named
executed.why: 检索到的是时间或付费意愿，没有存下同对象正文。尚未完成。

executed.support: trend in population ability to recognize and prefer nutritious food taste
executed.counter: Pew: taste remains the top priority, which is not elevation of taste under a general good-food standard
executed.why: 83% 把味道看得很重要。稳定而普遍的好食物标准这一条件没有出现。不计分。

executed.support: home cooking still a source of family emotion
executed.counter: same search; qualitative studies say love and care remain attached
executed.why: PMC PDF 地址返回的是 HTML。情感仍附在家常烹饪上这一方向有检索结果，但没有可引用原档。尚未完成。

executed.support: household hours declined while sanitation improved
executed.counter: Ramey: prime-age women's home production time fell, per capita time rose slightly; sanitation and beauty are not in that sentence
executed.excerpt: fell by around six hours from 1900 to 1965 and by another 12 hours from 1965 to 2005
executed.why: 期刊是 2009 年 3 月。工时下降不是卫生更好、更多美和更少工作这三件一起。人均家务时间还略升。不计分。

executed.support: parent time with children versus housework since 1965
executed.counter: childcare hours are not personal acquaintance, and the condition is removal of common labors from the home
executed.why: 陪伴时数不是亲自认识孩子。条件是家中的共同劳动被移走。不计分。

executed.support: housing trend private bedrooms and common rooms or cohousing
executed.counter: Danish cohousing is a small alternative, not the general form of rooms
executed.why: 私人住宅加公共设施的合作居住存在，但是少数形式。原句是将有私人房间、家庭房屋和公共房间这一安排。少数存在既不能判成已经实现，也不能判成没有。不计分。

executed.support: men's fathering changed because mothers gained economic independence
executed.counter: fathers' extra solo care is not a new kind of man grown from the new motherhood
executed.why: 2012 年 3 月。父亲单独照料增加不是一种新的男人长成。不计分。
